My dear [Mrs Keble](/person/797)
How very stupid and ungrateful you must have thought me, but I never saw [your Son](/person/799)’s letter when I opened – and answered yours, and only found it this morning.
It satisfies me all the more as being what I was always inclined to think.

yours affectionately

C M Yonge
